_about: What each table position leads to, per league season, for the zone legend on the league pages. A season's table decides the NEXT season's places: the 2026-27 tables fill the 2027-28 European competitions. `from` and `to` are inclusive positions. Places by league position only: a domestic cup winner, a title holder or a European Performance Spot can move them, which each league's note says. Checked 2026-11-04; re-check every summer and when the European Performance Spots are known (end of the season).

sources.europe: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027%E2%80%9328_UEFA_Champions_League (2026 association coefficients: 1 England, 2 Italy, 3 Spain, 4 Germany, 5 France, 6 Portugal, 7 Netherlands; edited 2 Nov 2026) with the Europa League and Conference League access lists from 2024-25
sources.nl: KNVB: reglement play-off Europees ticket 2026/27 (4th to 7th) and promotie- en degradatieregeling 2026/27 (16th play-off, 17th and 18th down)

kinds.ecl_po: Play-offs for a Conference League place

en-1.note: The FA Cup winner also goes to the Europa League and the League Cup winner to the Conference League. A fifth Champions League place goes to England if it ends the season in the top two of UEFA's country ranking.

it-1.note: The Coppa Italia winner also goes to the Europa League. A fifth Champions League place goes to Italy if it ends the season in the top two of UEFA's country ranking.

es-1.note: The Copa del Rey winner also goes to the Europa League. A fifth Champions League place goes to Spain if it ends the season in the top two of UEFA's country ranking.

de-1.note: The DFB-Pokal winner also goes to the Europa League. A fifth Champions League place goes to Germany if it ends the season in the top two of UEFA's country ranking.

fr-1.note: The Coupe de France winner also goes to the Europa League.

pt-1.note: The Taça de Portugal winner goes to the Europa League.

nl-1.note: The KNVB Cup winner goes to the Europa League. Fourth to seventh play off for one Conference League qualifying place.

en-2.note: The top two go up to the Premier League; third to sixth play off for the third place.
